key_provisions_or_claims: Adds EN 81-76:2025 to Annex I of Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76
Compliance with EN 81-76:2025 gives presumption of conformity with Directive 2014/33/EU
Standard covers evacuation of persons with disabilities using lifts
Enters into force on day of publication in the Official Journal
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/2383 amends Decision 2021/76 by adding harmonised standard EN 81-76:2025 on evacuation of persons with disabilities using lifts, conferring presumption of conformity with Lifts Directive 2014/33/EU. Not AI-related.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/2383 of 25 November 2025 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 as regards the harmonised standard on safety rules for the construction and installation of lifts regarding the evacuation of persons with disabilities using lifts
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/2383 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 as regards the harmonised standard on lifts and evacuation of persons with disabilities
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
